claim: In Gravesend, round or star-shaped places built of sectors were cheapest laid as shapes over one another with joints and paint from one table; rings were split into arcs and exempted from light cutting, because the light stage's cuts of the Cabal's three round tiers cost 600 walls.
evidence: Gravesend's Cabal circle, 2026-11-24 (projects/blood-city/level/cabal_rite.py:144-153), when the city stood at about 13,900 of 16,384 walls; bloodmap/light_stage.py:250-253 (LightRule.cut: the tiers' cuts cost 600 walls)
use: bloodmap.arrangement for round places; give their light rule cut=False.

checked.how: bloodmap/arrangement.py read (add/resolve/lay, arc() at :47, lay at :201); projects/blood-city/level/cabal_rite.py:144-153 lays gallery, tiers and floor as arcs 'so each is lit by the fires nearest it without being cut'; bloodmap/light_stage.py:250-253 LightRule.cut docstring: 'the cuts of the Cabal's three round tiers cost 600 walls'.
